feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Kailangang agad ipasuri sa pasilidad kahit isang danger sign lang, at higit sa isa na ang kay Niko.
feedback_by_option.en: Right. Any one general danger sign needs urgent facility assessment, and Niko already has more than one.

feedback_by_option.fil: Naaantala ang lunas kapag hinintay ang lahat ng senyales. Sapat ang isang danger sign para agad mag-refer.
feedback_by_option.en: Waiting for every sign delays care. One danger sign is enough to refer urgently.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi makainom si Niko at isinusuka ang lahat. Huwag painumin ang batang hindi ligtas lumunok.
feedback_by_option.en: Niko cannot drink and vomits everything. Do not give anything by mouth to a child who cannot safely swallow.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag magbigay ng diagnosis. Ang pasilidad ang magpapasya; ang nakita ang iuulat mo.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not label the illness. The facility decides; your handover gives what was observed.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Inuulit ng factual na handover ang eksaktong danger signs na iniulat at nakita.
feedback_by_option.en: Right. A factual handover repeats the exact danger signs reported and observed.

feedback_by_option.fil: Kapag may inalis na senyales, natatago ang pagka-urgent. Sabihin ang eksaktong nakita.
feedback_by_option.en: Leaving out signs hides how urgent this is. State the exact signs you found.
